name: STAND
cue: Stand tall with hands on hips.

name: STEP
cue: Take a long forward step, keeping feet hip width apart.

name: LOWER
cue: Bend both knees and lower with control.

name: BOTTOM
cue: Keep the front heel down and torso tall.

name: DRIVE BACK
cue: Drive through the front heel to begin returning.

name: RESET
cue: Return to standing and alternate sides.
